text:
omar: Okay team, hear me out — I propose we settle the Great Coffee Cup Question with a proper Coffee Saber Duel this Friday at 3pm in the breakroom. Bring a disposable stirrer. :coffee:

tess: wait explain "Coffee Saber Duel" 😅

omar: two people, each gets a disposable stirrer and a paper cup fortress. Hit the opponent's cup to spill exactly one bean. First to spill the bean wins. Winner gets to keep the Cerulean Spoon (ritual spoon from last year).

ben: patented productivity innovation or chaos? :thinking_face:

lina: obsessed. also we need rules. what if the cup is fortified with tape?

omar: rules (provisional):
```
1) No taping, gluing or metal reinforcements. Paper cup only.
2) One stirrer per challenger, standard wooden disposable stirrer only (no chopsticks).
3) Bean must fully leave the cup. If it bounces out and lands back in, point stays contested.
4) Best of 3 rounds. Judge is the person not dueling in the round.
5) Be safe. No full-force flinging at faces. Playful chaos encouraged.
```

marcus: @omar this is dangerously close to officially sanctioned lore. i'm in. i will bring official music playlist: "Epic Brewing"

alex: i will defend the honor of my mug. also can we add a consolation prize for the person who invents the best cup-gimmick? :trophy:

kb-bot: poll created — "Coffee Saber Duel: Will you participate?" Options: Yes / Maybe / Only as spectator. Vote in #random-polls

tess: voted "Only as spectator" (i will cheer and document on my phone) :camera_with_flash:

ben: voted Yes. will bring an emergency napkin fortification kit for cleaning duties.

lina: maybe — only if prizes include a free bag of beans.

omar: logistics: 3pm Friday, breakroom. @security if anyone wants to sweep room after for suspicious splashes pls advise. :)

marcus: can we get a tiny plaque for the winner that says "Keeper of the Cerulean Spoon"? very important for the lore arc.

alex: I'll engrave one. low-effort, maximum lore.

omar: Official ceremonial chant pending. proposals welcome. :drum:

lina: "By the beans and bounding foam, honor to the last pour" is my bid.

omar: love it. This thread is now the canonical invite. See you Friday. :coffee: :crossed_swords:
